site_name: 40-43 Andrews Road and Ash Grove Bus Garage
evidence_slice: Hackney Council identifies HC10, 40-43 Andrews Road and Ash Grove Bus Garage, as a Site Allocation in adopted Local Plan 2033. The council's Ash Grove SPD page says the site-specific guidance is intended to support future delivery of new homes, workspace including retail and office space, and an electrified bus garage. The draft SPD consultation ran from 8 July to 23 September 2024, and the current page states responses are being reviewed for the final version.
